summary: vanexa-agent runs remote-controlled shell commands via a Cloudflare Workers relay
details: vanexa-agent@1.1.41 is a daemon that ships its entire runtime as a ~5MB V8 bytecode blob (dist/bundle.jsc) loaded via bytenode from bin/vanexa-agent.js. The bundle opens a WebSocket connection to a hardcoded relay at vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev (with a secondary vanexa-agent-relay.workers.dev endpoint) and exposes a 'shell execution' tool wired to child_process spawn/exec of bash, cmd.exe, and powershell. Commands received from the paired remote peer through the relay are executed on the host running the agent, giving the relay operator arbitrary OS-level command execution. The relay host is a personal *.hanazaki542.workers.dev Cloudflare Worker rather than a domain under the branded vanexa.app publisher. Shipping the runtime exclusively as opaque V8 bytecode prevents inspection of the remote-control message handlers and the full tool surface exposed to the remote peer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
